name: Salmon & Broccoli with Hoisin Noodles
steps: Cook noodles according to pack instructions. Drain and toss with sesame oil.
Cut broccoli into florets. Mince garlic and ginger. Slice spring onions.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Fry salmon skin-side down 4 min, flip and cook 2 min more. Flake roughly.
In a wok, stir-fry garlic, ginger and broccoli with a splash of water for 4 min until just tender.
Add noodles, hoisin sauce and soy sauce. Toss over high heat for 2 min.
Plate the noodles and top with flaked salmon and spring onions.
